name: PT Sinergi Inti Plastindo Tbk
summary: PT Sinergi Inti Plastindo Tbk produces and distributes plastic packaging products in Indonesia. It offers high density polyethylene; low density polyethylene / low linear density polyethylene, including plastic and courier bags; PVC cling wrap; and degradable sealed bags. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia.
